simple.meaning: אֲרָא (ʼărâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ara , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H690. Ara אֲרָא proper name, masculine (meaning unknown, Thes conjectures = אֲרִי lion ) a descendant of Asher 1Chr 7:38 . אַרְאֵלִי אֶרְאֵל, see אֲרִיאֵל below I. ארה .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
